about_the_game:
Almora Darkosen: The Definitive PC Edition

The mobile hack-and-slash game, praised by millions of players, has been improved for its definitive debut on PC!

The original Almora Darkosen quickly became a favorite in the mobile RPG sphere. Thanks to its enduring popularity and dedicated player engagement, the game has been improved for a PC version. This is the ultimate way to experience Almora.

What's improved in The PC Definitive Edition?

All key areas were addressed to ensure the game feels like a native PC title, not a simple port:

  • Expanded View & True HD: Enjoy a significantly larger playfield and range of view thanks to Full HD (1080p) resolution support.

  • Next-Level Combat: Battles are more engaging with more monsters in every encounter and improved enemy AI.

  • Visual Remaster: The world has been brought to life with more vegetation, richer environmental details, advanced visual effects, particles, and physics.

  • Native PC Control: The entire Graphical User Interface (GUI) has been re-engineered for seamless mouse and keyboard interaction. Enjoy full and configurable mouse/keyboard and gamepad support.

  • Play Anywhere on Steam: Fully compatible with the Steam Deck console. Experience Almora without any loss of quality, wherever you want to play!

Monetization: NO Microtransactions, NO Loot Boxes, NO Pay-to-Win. Buy once, play forever!

ABOUT THE GAME:

Immerse yourself in a vast, open world filled with mysteries and dangers, and spend countless hours exploring, fighting, and developing your character.

EXPLORE THE EXPANSIVE ISLAND OF ALMORA:

Traverse diverse locations, from lush fields and dark forests to treacherous swamps, ancient crypts, and vast deserts. Discover hidden caves, dungeons, and towns, filled with treasures, quests, and secrets to uncover.

GAME FEATURES:

  • Classic retro-style RPG: Experience the nostalgia of old-school RPGs with pixelated graphics and engaging gameplay.

  • Engaging storyline: Take part in an epic adventure filled with main and side quests that will provide you with hours of entertainment.

  • Extensive item system: Find and use hundreds of items, such as swords, axes, shields, armor, potions, and more.

  • Crafting and mining: Create your own items, upgrade them, and search for valuable minerals in mines.

  • Mercenaries: Hire a companion to fight alongside you and face hordes of monsters together.

  • Diverse enemies: Battle bosses and unique monsters, each with their own skills and tactics.

  • NPC interactions: Meet the inhabitants of Almora, discover their stories, and complete quests for them.

  • Character progression: Choose a skill path that best suits your playstyle and become a powerful hero.

  • In-game encyclopedia: Gain knowledge about items, monsters, and crafting through the built-in encyclopedia.

  • Achievements and stats: Track your progress and earn achievements for completing challenging tasks.

  • Almorian Dice mini game: Relax and gain some gold in dice game available in taverns and hidden locations.

  • New Game+: Finish the game and start a new adventure at a higher difficulty level.

ARE YOU READY TO EXPLORE THE ISLAND?
